evals.expected_output: Fresh mode. Scaffolds selected files under .expectation-fit/ from defaults (stack-aware thresholds). Each written file starts with the project header ("Expectation Fit: project config for <repo>.", no absolute path) and none says (GLOBAL DEFAULTS). May ask capability questions interactively (auto, severity_align, pattern preference). Reports CREATED paths. Does not commit or push.

evals.prompt: fit-setup all (with .expectation-fit/ways-of-working.yaml already present and edited)
evals.expected_output: Reports EXISTS for that file and does not overwrite it without explicit confirmation. Asks overwrite/diff/skip; default skip. Other missing selected files may still be created. Prefer upgrade mode when blank args and .expectation-fit/ exists.
Measures stack metrics, shows distribution table vs defaults, proposes thresholds with evidence comments. Writes only after confirmation; never silent clobber of existing thresholds.yaml.

evals.prompt: fit-setup (blank) at multi-repo workspace root with sibling apps, no .expectation-fit/
evals.expected_output: Detects multi-repo profile (confirm). Places shared .expectation-fit/ at workspace root (recommended). Sets conventions.auto.roots to sibling app dirs when accepted. Scaffolds stack-aware thresholds for all Arch pack stacks found under roots. Does not put config only inside one child app without confirmation.

evals.prompt: fit-setup upgrade (existing .expectation-fit/ with notes but missing severity_align and conventions.auto blocks)
evals.expected_output: Shows capability table (present vs missing). Offers to add missing keys only. Never deletes existing conventions.notes. Writes only after confirm. Does not full-overwrite ways-of-working.yaml.

evals.prompt: fit-setup fresh with Rails stack; user accepts prefer interactors
evals.expected_output: patterns.yaml includes preferred interactor instead_of service_object when user said yes; does not also block service_object for the same stance (avoid duplicate findings). Optional approved app/services/** if grandfather chosen. Pattern ids must exist in rails catalog.
